description: The only /lineside geometry as of 2026-08-17. Display-only; no TD, learner, signal or train-model behaviour changes.

source.kind: live TD plus SMART berth metadata
source.evidence: D1/1696 received a CC interpose for 9U95; SMART identifies it as Reading platform 14. Independent Tracksy observation confirmed the train at Reading platform 14.

sidings.evidence: 1669 is the normal Down Relief route (3150 dwell samples, 31.5 s mean; dominant 1665 -> 1669 -> 1677). 1679 branches from 1669, has only 36 dwell samples with a 424 s mean, and rejoins toward 1687. Although SMART assigns both to KEN BG LP, the learner's branching and dwell evidence identifies 1679 as the loop/stabling berth.

evidence: Field observation: the house lies immediately east of Twyford and is straddled by the Up Main 1640/1626 progression
alignment.limitations: Intermediate columns are deliberate schematic interpolation. They improve line-to-line alignment and local topology but do not claim surveyed berth spacing.

geometry_rules.crossovers: Connect running-track gaps, never berth cells; use diagonal leads only.
geometry_rules.multi_track_moves: A move across two rows is represented by adjacent-track crossover ladders and short runs on intermediate tracks; never by a direct connector.
geometry_rules.turnback_leads: Maidenhead turnback leads must run from the platform approach gaps to the turnback berth.
